description: Build a concrete UI Lab direction brief from a product archetype, visual language, Omoro style and optional palette. Returns layout geometry, palette roles, typography/material guidance, keep/avoid rules and a paste-ready prompt.

clientBrief.description: Optional client direction or project brief to incorporate into the prompt.

language.description: UI Lab visual language key, for example technical, swiss, industrial or cinematic.

palette.description: Optional Omoro palette slug. Use search_palettes or list_palettes first.

product.description: UI Lab product key, for example creative, commerce, analytics or developer.

promptMode.description: Prompt emphasis: Omoro system, client brief, or a synthesis of both. Defaults to synthesis when clientBrief is supplied.

style.description: Omoro style slug. Use search_styles or list_styles first.

name: build_ui_direction
